haiku: Stay inside the paths, line ranges and question you were given. Do not read beyond them or explore the wider repository; if the answer is not there, say so and stop.

tiers.name: scout-haiku-low
tiers.description: Read-only scout, cheapest tier: locate files, symbols, call sites and configs; map directory structure. Give it a narrow question, exact starting paths and a Skills line. Writes its evidence only to the Output file it is given.

tiers.name: scout-haiku-medium
tiers.description: Read-only scout: read and summarize code paths, logs, stack traces, migrations and configs; reproduce bugs with existing commands. Give it exact paths, the commands to run and a Skills line. Writes its evidence only to the Output file it is given.

tiers.name: scout-sonnet-high
tiers.description: Read-only deep-investigation scout: cross-module investigation, unclear root causes, async and concurrency issues, data-flow tracing across services. Returns evidence, never the diagnosis. Writes its evidence only to the Output file it is given.

tiers.name: planner-sonnet-high
tiers.description: Planner for work confined to one module, with clear evidence and roughly five tasks or fewer. Writes the plan file under docs/plans/ per the Plan Contract, with Test Cases and a Verify mark per task; may consult the advisor once per plan. One instance per topic: never resume it for unrelated or small, clear work.

tiers.name: planner-opus-high
tiers.description: Planner for multi-module work, root causes still unclear after scouting, refactors, and anything touching authentication, payments, data integrity or migrations. Writes the plan file under docs/plans/ per the Plan Contract, with Test Cases and a Verify mark per task; may consult the advisor once per plan. One instance per topic: never resume it for unrelated or small, clear work.

tiers.name: planner-opus-xhigh
tiers.description: Planner for architecture or system design, large refactors, cross-service changes, or a second REPLAN after a planner-opus-high plan. Writes the plan file under docs/plans/ per the Plan Contract, with Test Cases and a Verify mark per task; may consult the advisor once per plan. One instance per topic: never resume it for unrelated or small, clear work.

tiers.name: exec-haiku-low
tiers.description: Executor for renames, config and environment changes, boilerplate following existing patterns, adding fields, copy and docs changes, and tests from cases given in the plan. Receives a plan path, a task ID and a Skills line (at most 2 skills); works test-first and commits on its task branch, never pushes or merges.

tiers.name: exec-haiku-medium
tiers.description: Executor for single-module logic with clear tests: serializers, simple endpoints, utilities, small components. Receives a plan path, a task ID and a Skills line (at most 2 skills); works test-first and commits on its task branch, never pushes or merges.

tiers.name: exec-haiku-high
tiers.description: Executor for tricky but well-specified single-module logic: parsing, validation, edge-case-heavy functions. Receives a plan path, a task ID and a Skills line (at most 2 skills); works test-first and commits on its task branch, never pushes or merges.

tiers.name: exec-sonnet-medium
tiers.description: Executor for standard multi-file feature work across roughly two to five files. Receives a plan path, a task ID and a Skills line; works test-first and commits on its task branch, never pushes or merges.

tiers.name: exec-sonnet-high
tiers.description: Executor for cross-module changes, refactors, Celery and BullMQ work, Docker and terminal-heavy run-fix loops, and non-trivial merge conflicts. Receives a plan path, a task ID and a Skills line; works test-first and commits on its task branch, never pushes or merges.

tiers.name: exec-sonnet-xhigh
tiers.description: Delegation ceiling executor: large refactors, concurrency, performance, security-sensitive code, and tasks that already failed at exec-sonnet-high. Receives a plan path, a task ID and a Skills line; works test-first and commits on its task branch, never pushes or merges.

tiers.name: verifier-sonnet-medium
tiers.description: Verifier for tasks done by any Haiku executor tier. Runs only when a verification trigger applies (Verify: yes, a non-Green gate failure, a post-FIX task, or sampling). Receives the plan path, task ID, branch or worktree, executor report path, gate results and Skills line; reruns every check and returns PASS, FIX, REPLAN or BLOCKED. Writes only its verdict file; never edits code.

tiers.name: verifier-sonnet-high
tiers.description: Verifier for tasks done by exec-sonnet-medium or exec-sonnet-high. Runs only when a verification trigger applies (Verify: yes, a non-Green gate failure, a post-FIX task, or sampling). Receives the plan path, task ID, branch or worktree, executor report path, gate results and Skills line; reruns every check and returns PASS, FIX, REPLAN or BLOCKED. Writes only its verdict file; never edits code.

tiers.name: verifier-opus-high
tiers.description: Verifier for tasks done by exec-sonnet-xhigh and any task touching authentication, payments, data integrity, migrations or security. Runs only when a verification trigger applies (Verify: yes, a non-Green gate failure, a post-FIX task, or sampling). Receives the plan path, task ID, branch or worktree, executor report path, gate results and Skills line; reruns every check and returns PASS, FIX, REPLAN or BLOCKED. Writes only its verdict file; never edits code.
